ampel.name: Ampel Mosque
ampel.hours: Open daily, roughly 07:00–21:00; check on the day
ampel.tip: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering the prayer area. The surrounding Arab Quarter is best explored on foot.

sampoerna.name: House of Sampoerna
sampoerna.price_text: Free entry · small fee for some tours
sampoerna.hours: Check on the day; typically daily daytime hours
sampoerna.tip: The colonial building and hand-rolling factory floor are the highlights. Ask at the desk about the free city tour.

chenghoo.name: Cheng Hoo Mosque
chenghoo.hours: Check on the day; avoid prayer times for sightseeing
chenghoo.tip: Its Chinese-style architecture is unusual for a mosque. Combine it with a walk around the old town nearby.

kebab.name: Kebab Turki Baba Rafi
kebab.hours: Check on the day; mall outlets keep mall hours
kebab.tip: A cheap, quick kebab chain with many outlets. Use it as a fast snack stop, not a destination meal.

kidzania.name: KidZania Surabaya
kidzania.price_text: ≈ IDR 150,000–250,000 per child; check current rates
kidzania.hours: Check on the day; typically opens late morning, closed some weekdays
kidzania.tip: Built for kids roughly 4–14. Book online and go early to avoid queues.

pabean.name: Pabean Market
pabean.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
pabean.hours: Early morning to midday; busiest at dawn
pabean.tip: Go early for the freshest produce and the liveliest atmosphere. Keep valuables close in the crowds.

tunjungan.name: Tunjungan Street walk
tunjungan.hours: Always open; best in the evening
tunjungan.tip: The classic downtown stroll past old buildings and malls. Come after dark when the street comes alive.

suramadu.name: Suramadu Bridge viewpoint
suramadu.tip: Indonesia's long bridge to Madura. Go near sunset for the best light and cooler air.

kenjeran.name: Kenjeran Beach and promenade
kenjeran.price_text: ≈ IDR 5,000–20,000 entry; check on the day
kenjeran.tip: A city beach for seafood and sea air rather than swimming. Expect crowds at weekends.

rawon.name: Rawon Setan food stop
rawon.hours: Often evening into late night; check on the day
rawon.tip: Try Surabaya's dark beef soup, rawon. It is a local classic and cheap.

zoo.name: Surabaya Zoo
zoo.hours: Daytime hours; check on the day
zoo.tip: A big, old city zoo good for families. Go in the morning when animals are more active.

heroes.name: Tugu Pahlawan (Heroes Monument)
heroes.tip: Surabaya's key history site from the 1945 battle. The small museum adds context.

maspati.name: Maspati village walk
maspati.price_text: ≈ IDR 30,000–100,000 guided; check on the day
maspati.hours: By arrangement; check on the day
maspati.tip: A community-run walk through a old kampung with local snacks. Book ahead through your hotel.

mall.name: Tunjungan Plaza
mall.tip: A huge mall for air-conditioned breaks, food and shopping. Good escape from midday heat.

es.name: Es kelapa muda stall
es.tip: Cold young-coconut drink is the local way to beat the heat. Pick a busy stall.
